intro: Declutter your workspace by removing unwanted pins and bloatware from the Windows Start Menu.

⚠️ Setting Persistence

Settings found in the Customizations view are not persistent. Winhance applies these changes once, but it does not use background tasks to re-apply them if they are changed later by Windows or by you manually.

html:
ℹ️ Windows Edition Differences

Windows 11 Pro and above: The Recommended section is completely removed from the Start Menu.

Windows 11 Home: The Recommended section remains visible but is disabled—no items will be shown there.
